insight: Free-tier transcription runs on small AI models fully on-device, so audio need not leave your machine; cloud models are Pro-only.
name: superwhisper
tagline: Turn your voice into polished text in any app.
description: A voice-to-text dictation app that transcribes speech into formatted, cleaned-up text system-wide across any application. Per-mode model selection lets you assign different local or cloud models to different tasks, with meeting recording, file transcription, and custom vocabulary on top.

modelSupport.notes: Per-mode choice of local Whisper-family models or cloud models (cloud reserved for Pro).

edge: On-device local models on the free tier mean dictation that never uploads your audio — privacy most cloud-only dictation apps can't match.
cons: Mac is the most mature platform
Larger local models need more RAM
